title: Riddles: Only 1% Get All 3 Right
hook: Only 1% solve all three riddles. Can YOU?
script:
Only 1% of people can solve all three of these tricky riddles. Can YOU?
Let's find out! Riddle one: What has an eye but cannot see? Five seconds. Go! Time's up!
It's a needle. Did you get it? The next one's tougher.
Riddle two: What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish? Five seconds. Think! Stop!
That's a map! How'd you do on that brain-teaser?
Final challenge, riddle three: What is full of holes but still holds water? Your last five seconds start now. Good luck! Time!
The answer is a sponge! How many did you solve correctly? Share your score below.
If you aced all three, you're officially in the top 1% who can solve these tricky riddles!
